data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘fæger’ meaning ‘beautiful, fair’. The name Fairman refers to someone who is just and fair in their actions. The name Fairman carries the meaning “Just” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fairman usually hope their child will grow to embody just and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fairman total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
